subject.title: [Feature] Prune stale orphaned sessions from Dashboard Sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a cross-channel Dashboard prune flow for orphaned Telegram/Discord sessions, and what reachability, retention, default-age, and auto-prune policy should it use?
rationale: The request deletes persistent session rows based on external channel reachability, which needs maintainer policy for false positives, transcript retention, plugin ownership, permissions, and new config/default behavior.

options.title: Preview-first Dashboard prune
options.body: Add a Dashboard candidate preview backed by plugin-owned reachability checks, then revalidate and delete only after explicit user confirmation.

options.title: Narrow Discord cleanup first
options.body: Resolve the narrower Discord thread/channel orphan case in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50310 before designing a broader Telegram/Discord Dashboard flow.

options.title: Keep manual cleanup only
options.body: Keep selected-row deletion and generic CLI cleanup as the supported paths and decline automatic orphan pruning for now.

recommendation.title: Preview-first Dashboard prune
recommendation.body: Add a Dashboard candidate preview backed by plugin-owned reachability checks, then revalidate and delete only after explicit user confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across session Dashboard controls, gateway session deletion, and session thread management.
